mechanism: Bind the original strip width to both perpendicular existing elbow projections. Targets counting the same fold elbow twice in material length: x+q+8=13, x=2q, giving10/3.
primary_math_proof: Let q be exposed height of Q and strip width w=4. The 45-degree fold consumes a w-by-w elbow. Original longitudinal material length is x+w+q=13. P=w*x and Q=w*q, so x=2q. Thus 3q=9,q=3,x=6 uniquely. An unfolded-coordinate check reflects the material tail beyond line y=u at the elbow to an upgoing tail; both displayed projections have length4 but describe the same elbow, so they must not both enter material length. Erroneous x+q+4+4=13 gives x=10/3. This preset differs from the old missing-elbow26/3 and old observed8.
